column2: #1647 Spec P3-1 / #1678 R2-F3 correction (append-only; earlier row untouched). Two defects in it: (1) `++`/`--` said to be 0 without pinning the metric - `grep -c '^++'` returns 2 because it matches `+++` headers; the 0 holds only under `git diff-tree -c -p <sha> | grep -cE '^\+\+[^+]'` / `'^--[^-]'` (re-ran: 54bb0c49b 0/0, b0f77cf39 0/0). (2) `git show --cc --name-only` listing sandbox/docker.py was cited as a counter-example; that is the file table, and a listed file is not a resolution line. The qualitative claim stands: no genuine resolution line, pure union. Wording only, no new content review, same immutable range.
